5 Subtle Mistakes Crushing Your YouTube Shorts Retention

If your YouTube Shorts are stuck at under 1,000 views, chances are you are making these silent algorithmic mistakes. Here is how to fix your video retention and watch time.
Most creators focus heavily on visual production quality, but YouTube's short-form algorithm prioritizes user behavior metrics like Swipe-Through Rate (STR) and Average Percentage Viewed (APV). Common mistakes include taking longer than 2 seconds to deliver on the title's premise, using slow verbal intros ("Hey guys, welcome back"), adding dead space between edit cuts, failing to optimize aspect ratios for mobile screens, and ignoring seamless narrative looping. Eliminating these structural friction points forces viewers to stay hooked through the entire duration. Here is a breakdown of retention curve editing, hook optimization, and algorithmic pacing.
